LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.label: First Feather
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.description: Awaken the power of flower, sword and bow, improving weapon damage, armor penetration and melee attack speed.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.label: Light Within the Blade
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.description: Further improve the power of all three weapon forms.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.label: Feather Law's Edge
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.description: Fully unleash the damage, armor penetration and melee attack speed of all three weapon forms.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.label: Scattered Feathers
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.description: Increase the number of projectiles in ordinary split-arrow attacks and Arrow Barrage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.label: Skywoven Formation
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.description: Unfurl more feather arrows to expand sustained fire.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.label: A Hundred Feathers Return
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.description: Fully unleash ordinary split-arrow attacks and Arrow Barrage.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.label: Faint Halo
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.description: Raises Neiyu's shield cap to 42 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.label: Sheltering Halos
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.description: Raises Neiyu's shield cap to 60 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.label: Clear Sky's Echo
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.description: Raises Neiyu's shield cap to 78 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.label: Faint Patterns
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.description: Awaken the laws within the everyday attire, inner layer and earrings, improving protection and restoring some equipment bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.label: Resonant Patterns
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.description: Further improve the attire's protection, insulation and equipment bonuses.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.label: Raiment Restored
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.description: Fully unleash the protection, insulation and equipment bonuses of the everyday attire, inner layer and earrings.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing1.story: As a feather brushes her palm, Neiyu remembers the weight of the first weapon she held. Keeping power upon the blade is harder than letting it pour forth.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing2.story: She wipes the faint light along the blade's spine. Its restrained brilliance blooms only at the moment of impact.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Wing3.story: Flower, sword and bow appear in her hands in turn. Their forms differ, but the same law always answers her.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow1.story: An arrow leaves the string, unfurling feathers of light. Neiyu begins to distinguish each faint echo.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow2.story: After the rain, threads of light cross the sky. Their interwoven paths slowly fall into order.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Arrow3.story: The sky's feather-light returns to the string, as still as if it had never left. At last, she can guide every feather to its own destination.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo1.story: As her body recovers, Neiyu can shape her halo again. She dresses it with petals. The halo is what protects her, so the stronger it grows, the harder her shield is to break.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo2.story: A Milira can have more than one halo. Just kidding. You can, however, make reflections of a real halo and stack them for a stronger effect. Her shield can now stand up to more hits.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo3.story: The halo fills with light. As Ji flows through it, something faint begins to answer. It almost seems to have a will of its own. Whatever it is, her shield has grown stronger again.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law1.story: The fabric's patterns reveal themselves only in the light. Following them, she reconnects the scattered power inch by inch.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law2.story: Her earrings and hem glow softly together. Once separate, the patterns begin to rise and fall with her breath.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Law3.story: She folds her wings, and the light upon her clothes fades with them. The law now rests against her body, with no need to proclaim itself.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon1.label: First Awakening
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon1.story: The remnant of her soul slowly wakes. After a long time gathering itself, it takes on a body again. Still bewildered, Neiyu reaches for a nearby Raiment Blossom. At the first touch of those pink petals, what she has to do begins to come back to her. There is so much left to do.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel1.descriptio: Improves the protection of ordinary clothing and its effects on movement speed, dodge chance, incoming damage and attack interval.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel1.story: Some of her memories of spell sigils return, and Neiyu manages to inscribe protective sigils on the clothes she made for herself. Sigils can do all sorts of things. Their effects mostly depend on the caster's imagination. "Anything is possible."
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon2.description: Increases weapon damage and armor penetration, shortens the sword form's attack interval, and adds more split arrows to the bow form's ordinary attacks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon2.story: She tempers her weapons with a star's energy. Sunlight, if you prefer. A weapon with more energy has more it can do.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel2.descriptio: Improves ordinary protection and the effects of worn gear on movement speed, dodge chance, incoming damage and attack interval.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel2.story: Lay one sigil over another and the effect grows stronger. As the fine lines build on each other, they can hold far more power than their size suggests. The fabric grows tougher and better at absorbing impacts.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon3.description: Increases weapon damage and armor penetration, shortens the sword form's attack interval, and adds more split arrows to the bow form's ordinary attacks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon3.story: She works her own feathers into her weapons. After tempering, they strike harder and feel more like a part of her. In other words, they just feel better in her hands.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel3.descriptio: Improves ordinary protection and the effects of worn gear on movement speed, dodge chance, incoming damage and attack interval.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel3.story: She puts a little of her own intent into the clothes she's been refining, along with petals from the Raiment Blossom she always carries. The clothes protect her better again.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon4.description: Increases weapon damage and armor penetration, shortens the sword form's attack interval, and adds more split arrows to the bow form's ordinary attacks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon4.story: Every strike now carries the power of Ji. The more naturally she handles her weapons, the more she can draw out of them.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel4.descriptio: Improves ordinary protection and the effects of worn gear on movement speed, dodge chance, incoming damage and attack interval.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel4.story: Streams of Ji shimmer around her clothes. With that light running through them, the fabric protects her far better than ordinary clothing could.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo4.description: Raises Neiyu's shield cap to 96 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Weapon5.description: Increases weapon damage and armor penetration, shortens the sword form's attack interval, and adds more split arrows to the bow form's ordinary attacks.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Apparel5.descriptio: Improves ordinary protection and the effects of worn gear on movement speed, dodge chance, incoming damage and attack interval.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Halo5.description: Raises Neiyu's shield cap to 108 layers.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Blessing1.descripti: Requires flower form. Cast for 1.1 seconds to heal wounds and old injuries on non-hostile flesh-and-blood targets in a selected area within 24 tiles and improve their mood. While blessed, movement speed increases by 20%, incoming damage falls by 10%, and immunity gain speed increases by 70%. Radius: 4 tiles. Blessing: 30 seconds. Cooldown: 120 seconds.

LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Skyfall1.descriptio: Requires sword form. Cast for 1 second, then leap to a chosen spot within 35 tiles. Enemies around the landing point take damage that ignores armor and become 25% more vulnerable to damage. Radius: 2 tiles. Landing damage: 60. Vulnerability: 15 seconds.

Enemies around the landing point take damage that ignores armor and become 25% more vulnerable to damage. Radius: 2.5 tiles. Landing damage: 90. Vulnerability: 20 seconds.

LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Barrage1.descriptio: Charge for 5 seconds in bow form, then fire 20 arrows in the chosen direction. Each arrow deals 30 base damage and has a range of 55 tiles.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Barrage2.descriptio: Charge for 5 seconds in bow form, then fire 26 arrows in the chosen direction. Each arrow deals 30 base damage and has a range of 55 tiles.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Barrage3.descriptio: Charge for 5 seconds in bow form, then fire 32 arrows in the chosen direction. Each arrow deals 30 base damage and has a range of 55 tiles.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Toxin1.description: In flower form, give enemies within 5 tiles of the Miasma Garden food poisoning and a 10% chance to go berserk.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Toxin2.description: In flower form, give enemies within 6 tiles of the Miasma Garden food poisoning and a 10% chance to go berserk.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Toxin3.description: In flower form, give enemies within 7 tiles of the Miasma Garden food poisoning and a 10% chance to go berserk.
LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Thunder1.descriptio: Cast for 1.2 seconds to mark units outside your faction within 3 tiles of a spot chosen up to 30 tiles away. You cannot mark yourself. Line of sight is not required. Divide the strike budget of 72 by the number of marked targets and round up to get the number of strikes per target. The first strike comes after 2–3 seconds, with 0.75–1.25 seconds between later strikes. Each deals 25 armor-ignoring damage and 15 EMP damage, and ignites flammable targets.

LanguageData.MX_Neiyu_Cultivation_Execution1.descript: In sword form, step back 2 tiles, then dash in and behead the target. If there is no removable head, deal 75 damage that ignores armor. Range: 20 tiles. Cooldown: 105 seconds.
